title: daily-scratchpad-gpu-ops-33
body:
2026-03-04 - quick scratchpad

Morning:
- Check Dedicated pool A (a100-80gb) utilization: target 75% avg. Observed 82% last 24h -> might need to add 4 nodes or scale burst capacity.
- H100 pool (private): 6/12 nodes reporting NVML errors; possible driver mismatch after kernel-5.15->6.1 upgrade. Ticket ENGINFRA-421.

TODO:
[ ] Add 4 a100-80gb nodes to dedicated-prod-autoscale group (scale policy: +4 nodes when 95th pct qps > 2500 for 10m)
[ ] Validate driver 525.105 rollout on h100-canary (kernel 6.1). See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/812
[x] Restarted node gpu-h100-07 (OOM during batch flushing) - kernel dmesg showed stale cgroup error
[ ] Run kv-cache warmup script on dedicated cache nodes before Canary rollout
[ ] Update runbook section: GPU driver rollback steps (confluence link)

Notes / Observations:
- GPU memory fragmentation on a100 nodes causing slower allocations for long-context models (8k+). Hypothesis: CUDA allocator fragmentation + multiple tenants -> consider reserved pre-allocation for pinned services.
- Prefix caching ratio improved after eviction tuning last week (cache hit rate 0.62 -> 0.71)

Quick commands:
- kubectl get pods -n dedicated | grep a100
- ssh gpu-admin@gpu-h100-07 'sudo cat /var/log/nvidia-installer.log | tail -n 200'
- /opt/infra/bin/kv-warmup --pool dedicated-cache --quiet

Open questions:
- Is it safe to bump driver across all h100s to 525.105? Can we limit to canary region eu-west for 24h?
- Need to confirm SLO change communicated to customer success for Dedicated customers when capacity constrained.

Links:
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGINFRA-421
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INFRA/GPU+Ops+Runbook
- Slack: #gpu-ops (thread ts: 1677891234.000100)

Notes-to-self:
- Follow up with Marco on network MTU changes (lowering to 9000 caused intermittent packet drops between racks)
- Add monitoring alert: NVML driver mismatch count > 3 in 15m -> page on-call

End of day quick recap: prioritize driver canary + capacity bump for a100. Capture metrics snapshot and send to eng-platform channel.
